reason: The primitive tetragonal cell (a about 4.399 A, c about 10.035 A), Z=1 for LaCePt4Ge4, and a physically plausible CaBe2Ge2-type average framework are well supported, but exact recovery is not. No comparable whole-pattern Rwp was supplied, and the trajectory optimized ad hoc peak heights/areas rather than demonstrating a satisfactory whole-profile fit. More importantly, every intensity refinement represented the two rare-earth positions by the same averaged La/Ce scattering factor, then the final CIF arbitrarily instantiated fully ordered La and Ce and thereby lowered the inferred symmetry from the tested P4/nmm average model to P4mm. The ordered P4mm realization was not compared against the P4/nmm mixed-occupancy model or other element-ordering realizations, so the submitted symmetry, occupancies, and La/Ce ordering are unsupported by the work shown; La and Ce are also nearly indistinguishable with Cu Kalpha diffraction. The framework geometry is plausible, but this unresolved discrete ordering/symmetry ambiguity and the absent whole-pattern validation warrant another attempt with explicitly instantiated alternatives and direct profile comparison.
